articles.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
articles.description: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
articles.description: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI
articles.description: A new AI-based software program is being launched to help air traffic controllers better navigate their jobs as the crossing guards of America's skies.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: AI hallucination nearly triggers US military operation
articles.description: “It’s important for service members to understand the uncertainty inherent to LLMs," a GovAI research scholar warns.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
articles.description: Though Elon Musk and Sam Altman have supported Dario Amodei's calls to slow the pace of AI development, Jensen Huang seems to feel differently.

articles.title: AI safety conversations have gotten unbelievable

articles.title: Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
articles.description: The notetaker offers a generous free plan, and that has resulted in over 400,000 monthly active users. The company said that over 1 million people have recorded meetings until now.

articles.title: A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers
articles.description: Jev, a new kind of AI model, is showing developers a cheaper and faster path to software intelligence.

articles.title: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
articles.description: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang. It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.
